response.original_title: Can I add someone to my MSC cruise?
response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) you can add a passenger to an existing MSC cruise booking, provided your cabin and the ship have remaining capacity. Your current stateroom must support an extra person (e.g., pull-down beds or a sofa bed) and cannot exceed maximum safety limits. If your current room is at capacity, +1-866-829-1280(US) you may need to switch to a larger cabin, subject to availability. Contact Directly: Call MSC Cruises +1-866-829-1280(US) or your travel agent to check availability and get an exact price quote for the addition. Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) you can add a passenger to your existing MSC cruise reservation by calling MSC Customer Service directly +1-866-829-1280(US) or contacting your travel agent, as additions cannot be made online.
